replay.subject: Water near radiator at 135 Willow Walk – reporting to Alderwick Mutual
replay.body:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your call. I am letting Alderwick Mutual know about the incident now. To make the claim, please send me:

1. Your policy number, if you have it to hand.
2. The date and roughly what time you first saw the water.
3. Which room(s) are affected and the type of floor (for example carpet, laminate, wood or tiles). Also tell me about any damage to ceilings below, walls or belongings.
4. Photos of the radiator, the pipework and the wet floor, taken before anything is moved or repaired if you can.
5. The heating engineer's findings when they have been: what caused the leak and what they repaired. Please keep their report and invoice, and any damaged parts they remove.

In the meantime, if it is safe to do so, please do what you reasonably can to stop more damage. For example, turn off the heating system or isolate the radiator, mop up the water and move belongings out of the wet area. Please do not throw away damaged flooring or items until the insurer says you can.

Kind regards,
Ian
Marshgate Risk
